contact.evidence_quote: Meet our Founder & Professor ... Pastor, Dr. Donald W. Neace has been in ordained ministry for almost 50 years. He holds a PhD in Philosophy in Theology. He has served as a pastor in Illinois, Virginia, and Florida. He is a published author, conference speaker, and evangelist. Dr. Neace and his wife, Lisa, have been married since 1979. They are the parents of two grown children and have three grandchildren.
